attchmntText: Rossell Techsys Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Rossell Techsys Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 06 November 2026. The company reported highest ever quarterly revenue of INR185.56 crores, up 47% year over year. EBITDA stood at INR29 crores with profit before tax at INR12.91 crores. Half-year revenue reached INR345 crores. The firm secured fresh orders worth approximately INR430 crores. It completed an INR300 crores capital raise. A new 140,000 sq ft facility was inaugurated. Inventory days improved to 6.67 months. The employee strength is 1,352. The transcript is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Rossell Techsys Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of Un-audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended30 September 2026
voiceSummary: Rossell Techsys Limited has published newspaper advertisements regarding its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The results were approved by the Board of Directors during its meeting held on 06 November 2026. The advertisements were published in the Economic Times English all India Edition and the Aajkal Bengali newspaper. The company has submitted copies of these advertisements to BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited for record. The BSE scrip code is 544294 and the NSE scrip symbol is ROSSTECH. This filing is pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. Krishnappayya Desai, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the communication on 07 November 2026.

attchmntText: Rossell Techsys Limited has informed the Exchange about Audio recording of Earnings Call pertaining to Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026
voiceSummary: Rossell Techsys Limited has filed an audio recording of its earnings call with BSE and NSE. The call was held on 06 November 2026. It covered the company overview, business highlights, financial performance, and other updates. The period discussed is the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The recording is available on the company website at https://rosselltechsys.com/investor-relations/shareholder-information. This filing is pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The notice was signed by Krishnappayya Desai, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.
